cards.title: RSL concede a lot of crosses
cards.data: 19.9 crosses conceded per game (#2 of 30, #1 = concedes the most).
cards.meaning: Opponents reach the flanks easily, and the box gets tested in the air.
cards.watch: Opposing fullbacks and wingers free to deliver, a long ball to the far post, set-piece pressure after blocked crosses.

cards.title: RSL build through the middle with the ball
cards.data: 55.7% possession (#7 of 30). Long balls are 10.6% of passes (#25 of 30, low = short passing).
cards.meaning: They keep the ball and build short. They want to dictate tempo and make the opponent chase.
cards.watch: Goalkeeper and center backs passing short, patient circulation, fullbacks high. The opponent sitting in a mid or low block.
cards.rule: Possession pct >= 70 and long ball share pct <= 40 (percentile vs MLS).

cards.title: RSL concede a lot of corners
cards.data: 5.2 corners conceded per game (#7 of 30, #1 = concedes the most).
cards.meaning: They are pushed back and clear the ball behind. Set pieces become a real chance source.
cards.watch: Opponents winning corners in bunches, mark-up and second balls decide it.

cards.title: RSL are out of form
cards.data: Last 5: 0.4 points per game (DLLDL) vs 1.2 on the season.
cards.meaning: Recent results are well below their season level.
cards.watch: Confidence and shape. Hot teams press and attack with energy early, cold teams tighten up and wait for mistakes.

cards.title: Demo United press high
cards.data: Approx PPDA 13.0 (#27 of 30, #1 = most passive). Opponents get few passes per defensive action.
cards.meaning: They squeeze the opponent early and try to win it high. This is a proxy built from tackles, interceptions and fouls, so treat it as likely, not certain.
cards.watch: Forwards closing the goalkeeper and center backs, a compact line pushed up, fouls in the opponent's half.
cards.rule: PPDA percentile <= 30. PPDA here = opponent passes / (tackles + interceptions + fouls).

cards.title: Demo United concede a lot of crosses
cards.data: 20.9 crosses conceded per game (#1 of 30, #1 = concedes the most).
cards.meaning: Opponents reach the flanks easily, and the box gets tested in the air.
cards.watch: Opposing fullbacks and wingers free to deliver, a long ball to the far post, set-piece pressure after blocked crosses.

cards.title: Demo United play direct
cards.data: Long balls are 20.0% of passes (#3 of 30). Possession 44.9% (#22 of 30).
cards.meaning: They skip the build-up. They are comfortable without the ball and look to win it and go forward fast.
cards.watch: Goal kicks and center back passes going long, second-ball fights in midfield, quick forward runs after a turnover.
cards.rule: Long ball share pct >= 70 and possession pct <= 50.

cards.title: Demo United concede a lot of shots
cards.data: 13.9 shots conceded per game (#6 of 30, #1 = concedes the most).
cards.meaning: Their structure lets opponents get shots away.
cards.watch: Opponents shooting from the edge of the box, midfield not tracking runners.

cards.title: Demo United are outscoring their chances
cards.meaning: They are scoring more than their chances suggest, which tends to cool off.
cards.watch: Look at shot quality: long shots and low-angle finishes mean the numbers are flattering.

cards.title: Demo United are in form
cards.data: Last 5: 1.6 points per game (DWLDW) vs 0.9 on the season.
cards.meaning: Recent results are well above their season level.
cards.watch: Confidence and shape. Hot teams press and attack with energy early, cold teams tighten up and wait for mistakes.

keys.title: RSL will cross, and Demo United allow it
keys.data: RSL average 24.0 crosses (#2 of 30). Demo United concede 20.9 (#1 of 30, #1 = most).
keys.meaning: RSL lean on crosses and Demo United do little to stop them.
keys.watch: RSL fullbacks and wingers getting to the byline, early deliveries, Demo United defenders clearing under pressure and giving up corners.
keys.rule: A crosses pct >= 65 and B crosses conceded pct >= 60.

keys.title: RSL create quality against a leaky Demo United defense
keys.data: RSL generate 1.29 xG per game (#4 of 30). Demo United concede 1.36 (#9 of 30, #1 = most).
keys.meaning: RSL get good chances and Demo United give them up.
keys.watch: RSL through balls and cutbacks, Demo United back line dropping or getting split.
keys.rule: A xG pct >= 65 and B xG conceded pct >= 60.

keys.title: Demo United's press meets RSL's short build-up
keys.data: Demo United approx PPDA 13.0 (#27 of 30). RSL possession 55.7%, long balls 10.6% (#25 of 30).
keys.meaning: RSL want to play out from the back and Demo United want to win it high. Whoever wins that fight sets the game.
keys.watch: Demo United forwards jumping on RSL goalkeeper and center backs, RSL either splitting the press with a quick pass or bailing out long.
keys.rule: A PPDA pct <= 35 (aggressive), B possession pct >= 60 and B long ball share pct <= 40.

keys.title: RSL shoot a lot against a team that concedes shots
keys.data: RSL take 13.6 shots (#8 of 30). Demo United concede 13.9 (#6 of 30, #1 = most).
keys.meaning: Expect plenty of RSL attempts. Volume is likely, quality is the question.
keys.watch: RSL shooting from outside the box, Demo United goalkeeper busy, blocked shots and rebounds.
keys.rule: A shots pct >= 65 and B shots conceded pct >= 60.

matchup.script: RSL average 56% possession and Demo United average 45%, so expect RSL to see roughly 55% of the ball. RSL should have more of it. RSL look like a possession side, Demo United like a direct side. Demo United will try to go over the top of RSL, so watch the space behind the RSL line after turnovers. The main battle: RSL will cross, and Demo United allow it.
